enabled.description: Whether to enable the GNSS share service (starts it on boot if true).

bind_interface.description: Network interface to listen on (e.g., eth0, wg0).

service_port.description: TCP port for the main GNSS data service (HTTP API).

stream_port.description: UDP port for raw GNSS data streaming (NTRIP, RTCM).

log_file.description: Path to the log file, or 'syslog' to use system logging.

pid_file.description: Path where the process PID file will be written.

worker_count.description: Number of worker threads (0 = automatically detect CPU count).

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

client_timeout.description: Idle timeout (seconds) for client connections before closing.

allowed_clients.description: List of allowed client IP addresses or CIDR subnets (empty list = allow all).

items.description: An IP address or CIDR subnet (e.g., 192.168.1.0/24, 10.0.0.5).

ssl_enabled.description: Enable TLS encryption for the HTTP service (requires certificate files).

ssl_cert_file.description: Path to SSL/TLS certificate file (PEM format). Required if SSL is enabled.

ssl_key_file.description: Path to SSL/TLS private key file (PEM format). Required if SSL is enabled.

gnss_sources.description: List of upstream GNSS data sources to fetch and re-share (e.g., NTRIP servers).

type.description: Protocol type of the source (ntrip, http, or file).

url.description: URL or path to the source (e.g., 'http://example.com/stream', or 'file:///data/rtcm').

format.description: GNSS data format of the stream.

auth_enabled.description: Enable HTTP Basic authentication for API access (requires users file).

auth_users_file.description: Path to JSON file with username:hash pairs for authentication (e.g., using bcrypt).
